content.text: Update @.github/workflows/daily.yml so it runs on push to main branch as well as daily
I'll update the trigger to include push events on main, alongside the existing schedule.

input.new_string:
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 5 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
